title: Extend raw-code erasure with paired cancellation and parity
statement: Identical program derivatives,paired cancellation and F(-z)=F(z) for the complete data/program circuit extend the exact-erasure raw-code receiver to error<=5eps p/8+4beta,beta=qTr(Ptau),with unchanged quadratic inverse-p0 training and no support oracle.

requires: Fixed finite-dimensional stationary memoryless source; data/reference and every fresh program independent conditional on ONE fixed source. Known accessible output-register type, trusted qutrit/ancilla gates, coherent whole-register SWAPs and quantum memory. No purification, inverse oracle, hidden flag, unknown eigenbasis or reusable decoder is supplied. Pure-isometry plus replacer. Local J includes retained-input-half transfer and is NOT supplied by ordinary remote calls. Labelled T uses known conjugates,not universal conjugation. Exact erasure needs tau V=0; coherent near-erasure first uses common-reset cancellation and whole-circuit parity before pinched-sector reasoning.
provides: Identical program derivatives,paired cancellation and F(-z)=F(z) for the complete data/program circuit extend the exact-erasure raw-code receiver to error<=5eps p/8+4beta,beta=qTr(Ptau),with unchanged quadratic inverse-p0 training and no support oracle.
assumptions: Near-erasure beta<=3epsilon_ent/p gives<=min(2,5eps p/8+12epsilon_ent/p),a stronger entropy tolerance requirement than noise-adapted frontier. Deterministic public12-state schedule consumes THIRTEEN programs per round and removes label averaging only. White-reset discarded-T deterministic-inverse lower n>=49/(64pi²p²zeta),zeta<=1/16, differs from exact-Delta0 fixed-code lower49/(64pi²p zeta). These are received-system PROGRAM tasks,not all raw labelled/adaptive or channel-composed recovery. Unrestricted WH3 entropy/VALUE and general mixed-success recovery remain OPEN. These conditional model theorems do not verify source promises, stationarity, Delta, hardware, novelty, advantage, unassisted capacity or finite-block coding.
costs: Charge every fresh training program, forward/reverse simulation, rejected/early-stop branches, original noisy datum (+1 call), validation/startup, preparation, holding/memory and classical processing. Gate width/storage depend on output dimension even when sample count does not. Each datum consumes a new bank; no free batching or demonstrated practical advantage. QPE cap1024 S²/zeta+2rm,S=r pi(M-1),M>=144/p0. Deterministic cycle cap6656 S²/zeta+13rm. Exact-erasure cap1024 S²/xi+18Lrm,xi=eps/2,S=9Lr pi(M-1). Every cap adds datum. Separate adaptive hidden-flag lower yields all-small-p Omega(p^-2) only for meaningful fixed fraction of p and sufficiently small RELATIVE complete error.
